start: Routine editor of a routine I made; profile goal 'Build muscle'; 'Reps to aim for' set to 'Match my goal'

steps.action: Add Barbell Bench Press to the routine
user_sees: A new row with the 'Sets' stepper, 'Rep min' 6 and 'Rep max' 10
must_not: 8-12 on a big barbell lift when the goal is Build muscle
A range a trainer or I set on another row changed

steps.action: Add Lateral Raise to the same routine
user_sees: The new row shows 'Rep min' 10 and 'Rep max' 15
must_not: The same range as the bench press
The bench press row changed by adding this one

steps.action: Leave the editor and open the routine's view page
user_sees: Each row's sets line shows its own range, for example 6-10 reps on the bench and 10-15 on the raise
must_not: A different range on the view page than in the editor

start: Settings, Workouts, More workout choices, 'How the app picks your next weight'; a routine with its own ranges

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Reps to aim for' with 'Match my goal' (Recommended), 'Strength', 'Muscle', 'Higher reps', each with its one line
The line 'Match my goal keeps the range each exercise has in its routine. Any other choice sets the range for every exercise.'
must_not: A choice without its plain line
No choice marked as picked

user_sees: The sheet closes and the row reads 'Higher reps' with '12-20 reps on every exercise'
must_not: The old choice still shown on the row

steps.action: Open the routine in the editor
user_sees: Rep min and Rep max steppers are replaced by '12-20 reps, from Settings -> More workout choices -> How the app picks your next weight (Higher reps).'
must_not: Steppers shown that would change nothing
The routine's own saved ranges overwritten in the database

steps.action: Start the routine and look at the Target on an exercise card
must_not: A Target still built on the routine's old 6-10

start: No profile goal (onboarding skipped); routine editor

steps.action: Add any exercise to a routine
user_sees: The new row gets 'Rep min' 8 and 'Rep max' 12
must_not: An error, a blank range or 0-0 reps

steps.action: Tap the minus on 'Rep max' until it reaches 'Rep min', then once more
user_sees: Rep max stops at the Rep min value
must_not: Rep max saved below Rep min
A crash or a red error

steps.action: Tap plus on 'Rep min' past 'Rep max'
user_sees: Rep max moves up with it, so the range stays whole
must_not: A range like 12-10 saved

start: Routine with rows of their own ranges (6-10 and 10-15); 'Reps to aim for' on 'Muscle'

steps.action: Switch 'Reps to aim for' back to 'Match my goal'
user_sees: The row reads 'Match my goal' and 'Each exercise keeps the range in its routine'
must_not: The choice not kept after leaving Settings

steps.action: Open the routine in the editor
user_sees: Each row shows its own Rep min and Rep max steppers with the values it had before 'Muscle' was picked
must_not: Rows left on the Muscle ranges
Rows reset to 8-12

start: Routine editor; a timed exercise (Plank) in the routine

user_sees: The row shows Sets but no Rep min or Rep max; a grey line in their place
must_not: Rep steppers on a timed exercise
A rep range that changes the timed Target

steps.action: Pick 'Strength' under 'Reps to aim for' and reopen the editor
user_sees: The Plank row is unchanged; only rep exercises show the chosen range line
must_not: '3-6 reps' printed on the Plank row
